# The Little Books of Generative AI Prompts

> The 2027 edition of The Little Books of Generative AI Prompts by Mark Anderson (ICT Evangelist): four books of tested AI prompts for people who work in schools in England. The site is a holding page for now and the prompts are coming soon.

Author: Mark Anderson (ICT Evangelist), https://ictevangelist.com
Licence: Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0.

## The four books

- The Little Book of Generative AI Prompts for Primary Teachers
- The Little Book of Generative AI Prompts for Secondary Teachers
- The Little Book of Generative AI Prompts for School and Trust Leaders
- The Little Book of Generative AI Prompts for Support Staff

## Work with Mark

- [Contact](https://ictevangelist.com/contact/): keynotes, INSET days, training and digital strategy support for schools and trusts
